notable_absence.finding: No access-control content on this page at all - time series is a data-modeling/document-structure convention plus an associated query function, not a gated statement or operator. The only gating fact on the page is the version-availability note.

cross_component_finding: Recurrence of the known docs-issue capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json: 'This feature is only available on clusters using Couchbase Server 7.2 or later.' - a literal server/-style version string on a Capella page, despite Capella having no discrete version numbers. Logged as a recurrence, not a new finding. Also links out to server/'s expiration concept ('you can set the [expiration](../../../server/current/learn/data/expiration.md) for your time series documents') and an SDK-authoring how-to guide ('Import Data with an SDK'), both shared cross-component content rather than anything Capella-specific.
